operational_parameters.description: Values that owners saved for the operational parameters declared by the runtime catalog in apps/api/src/parameters.ts (ADR-0028). The catalog owns each parameter's type, domain, installation default and effect; a missing row or a null value means the installation default applies. Secrets and bootstrap settings are never stored here.
operational_parameters.lifecycle: At most one row per catalog key, written only by owners through administration with strong recent authentication; a reset stores null instead of deleting. Every change is recorded in identity_audit_events with previous and new values.

key.description: Catalog key of the parameter, such as ai.model.

value.description: Saved JSON value in the catalog type of the key (string or array of strings).
value.nullMeaning: Reset by an owner; the installation default applies.

version.description: Concurrency token incremented by every change; an owner's change applies only to the version they saw.

updated_by.description: Person (identity_persons.id) who made the last change; historical attribution without a foreign key, because the authoritative trail is the identity audit.

updated_at.description: Application-clock instant of the last change; informational, not the concurrency token.

objects.operational_parameters_key_check: Only parameters declared by the catalog.
objects.operational_parameters_value_check: Each known key holds only its catalog type and domain (model identifier pattern, trace level, list of at most 32 strings).
